notes.title: Full Release!
notes.notes:
We think we've achieved what we set out to do with Vendor Chronicles now, and everything seems relatively stable. Of course, if you do encounter any bugs, please let us know in the forum (or email us, that's likely to get a quicker response) and we'll get to it as soon as we can.

Thank you for supporting Vendor Chronicles, and indie games in general. We love you!

notes.title: Most recent update!
notes.notes:
This should cover all known bugs! Now, onto more content!

(Fixed) Players not getting achievements unlocked
(Fixed) Players able to go minus balance when renting guns for repair purpose
(Fixed) Turret bug
(Fixed) Not able to defend self with gun under pillow
(Fixed) F12 not makes screenshots
(Fixed) Bargain Circle minigame's hitbox being shifted to the right
(Fixed) Being able to set Bargain difficulty level to value bigger then 6
(Fixed) Zombie's and raider's wave sometimes happen simultaneously
(Fixed) List auto scrolling to the top when selecting something in the bottom of the list

(Update) Increased turret and mercs price
(Update) Lowest possible price now is 10% of stock price
(Update) Added slider to the interface of lists
